facts.fact: Techno Time says the new data system operates alongside Egypt's Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020, which grants individuals rights over their data.
facts.system: Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020

facts.fact: Techno Time says the law's executive regulations were issued under Ministerial Decree No. 816 of 2025.
facts.system: Executive regulations, Ministerial Decree No. 816 of 2025

facts.fact: Techno Time says the Personal Data Protection Centre is responsible for supervising compliance with the law and regulating processing, including licensing and authorisation.
